subject.title: Sub-agent startup silence: no first-progress signal, aborted runs appear as hangs

question: Should OpenClaw add core lifecycle phases for sub-agent startup progress and typed startup failure, or solve the startup-silence problem within the existing lifecycle/terminal-outcome contract?
rationale: The source-repro is strong, but the proposed fix changes a core event surface consumed by gateway, SDK, session, and subagent paths, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Accept additive lifecycle phases
options.body: Add `first-progress` and typed `startup-failed` to the current embedded-agent lifecycle contract with gateway, SDK, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep existing phases and improve terminal metadata
options.body: Use existing `start`/`end`/`error` events plus terminal outcome metadata to expose startup aborts without a new event phase contract.

options.title: Defer until live corpus is replayable
options.body: Keep the issue open but require the representative transcript fixture or equivalent live repro before choosing the API shape.

recommendation.title: Accept additive lifecycle phases
recommendation.body: Add `first-progress` and typed `startup-failed` to the current embedded-agent lifecycle contract with gateway, SDK, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a core lifecycle/API product decision, and steipete is the most visible recent merger for the affected runtime surfaces in the available history.
